title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
title_zh: Gen4P：视频生成器是 4D 感知器

paragraphs.en: We introduce Gen4P , a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained multi-step video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io/ for more visual results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Gen4P，一个从单目视频中恢复 4D 几何与运动的统一框架。 我们表明，一个预训练的多步视频生成器可以被改造为前馈式 4D 感知器，而无需迭代去噪。 基于按需查询机制，Gen4P 在单次编码器前向传播中处理干净的视频潜变量，并通过轻量级交叉注意力解码器预测所请求的 4D 属性。 按需查询的形式支持灵活的空间采样，而我们提出的连续时间查询进一步提供了时间上的灵活性。 为增强几何知识，我们提出一种简单的即插即用方案，即引入一个预训练的视频深度 LoRA 作为冻结的几何先验，在不增加额外可训练参数的情况下提升整体性能。 Gen4P 在 3D 点跟踪、视频深度和相机位姿估计任务上取得了最先进或具有竞争力的性能。 在真实场景视频上的定性结果展示了其跟踪复杂运动同时保持精细结构的能力。 总之，这些结果证明了视频生成式预训练在统一 4D 感知方面的潜力。 更多可视化结果请参见 https://gen4p.github.io/。

paragraphs.en: We consider the problem of feed-forward full 4D reconstruction from monocular video. A unified 4D representation of scene geometry, depth, camera poses, and 3D point trajectories provides a foundation for simulating and interacting with the physical environment. However, recovering such a representation remains challenging: it requires accurately capturing both the static geometry and the dynamic motion of the scene across viewpoints and over time .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究从单目视频进行前馈式完整4D重建的问题。 场景几何、深度、相机位姿和3D点轨迹的统一4D表示为模拟物理环境并与之交互提供了基础。 然而，恢复这种表示仍然具有挑战性：它需要准确捕捉场景的静态几何以及跨视角、跨时间的动态运动。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in feed-forward reconstruction demonstrate the value of pretrained foundational vision models. Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs), including VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , build on pretrained vision models ( Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , adapting them through large-scale geometric supervision. These GFMs then provide strong geometry priors for subsequent 4D reconstruction: V-DPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) and 4RC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , for instance, extend VGGT and DA3 to jointly recover geometry and motion. However, geometry priors alone do not explicitly model how points should evolve over time in dynamic scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈重建的最新进展证明了预训练基础视觉模型的价值。 几何基础模型（GFMs），包括 VGGT（Wang et al., 2025a）、VGGT- \Omega（Wang et al., 2026a）和 DA3（Lin et al., 2025），构建于预训练视觉模型（Oquab et al., 2023; Siméoni et al., 2025）之上，并通过大规模几何监督对其进行适配。 这些 GFMs 进而为后续的 4D 重建提供强大的几何先验：例如，V-DPM（Sucar et al., 2026）和 4RC（Luo et al., 2026）分别扩展了 VGGT 和 DA3，以联合恢复几何与运动。 然而，仅凭几何先验无法显式地建模动态场景中各点应如何随时间演化。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, foundational generative models offer a complementary source of priors over appearance, geometry, and motion, by learning to synthesize images and videos ( Wan et al., 2025 ; ByteDance Seed Team, 2026 ) . Recent studies have exploited generative priors for 2D correspondence ( Hedlin et al., 2023 ) , depth estimation ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , 3D geometry recovery ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , motion tracking ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026a ) , and general perception ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . However, they still address 4D perception through task-specific approaches. Besides, they often require dense, frame-aligned supervision, limiting their flexibility in handling arbitrary spatiotemporal video inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，基础生成模型通过学习合成图像和视频（Wan et al., 2025；ByteDance Seed Team, 2026），为外观、几何和运动提供了互补的先验来源。 近期研究已利用生成先验完成了2D对应（Hedlin et al., 2023）、深度估计（Ke et al., 2024；Hu et al., 2025）、3D几何恢复（Zhang et al., 2025b；Lu et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2025）、运动跟踪（Zhu et al., 2026；Nam et al., 2026a）以及通用感知（Wang et al., 2026b）。 然而，它们仍然通过任务特定的方法来处理4D感知。 此外，它们通常需要稠密的、帧对齐的监督，这限制了它们处理任意时空视频输入的灵活性。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce Gen4P , a 4D perceiver that leverages rich priors from large-scale pretrained video generators for full 4D reconstruction. Specifically, Gen4P tames a multi-step video generator into a single-step feed-forward 4D perceiver. To this end, the objective is formulated as learning a direct regression network, instead of the iterative denoising for geometric reconstruction in prior works ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Such a formulation requires only one encoder forward pass per input clip. The resulting scene tokens are then shared across queries, reducing the encoding cost over repeated 4D predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 Gen4P，一个 4D 感知器，它利用大规模预训练视频生成器中丰富的先验来实现完整的 4D 重建。 具体而言，Gen4P 将多步视频生成器驯化为单步前馈的 4D 感知器。 为此，目标被设定为学习一个直接回归网络，而不是像先前工作（Ke et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2025; Lu et al., 2025）中那样通过迭代去噪进行几何重建。 这样的设定只需对每个输入片段进行一次编码器前向传播。 所得到的场景 token 随后在各个查询之间共享，从而降低了重复 4D 预测时的编码成本。

sents.zh: 这样的设定只需对每个输入片段进行一次编码器前向传播。

sents.zh: 所得到的场景 token 随后在各个查询之间共享，从而降低了重复 4D 预测时的编码成本。

paragraphs.en: We obtain the full 4D attributes by querying the scene tokens using a lightweight cross-attention decoder. It decouples the output sampling from pre-extracted feature grids, allowing spatial flexibility in the output resolution. Additionally, we introduce a continuous-time query mechanism to handle variable-length video sequences effectively. Furthermore, we discover that a pretrained video-depth LoRA can further be incorporated as a frozen plug-in geometric prior, strengthening geometry without introducing additional trainable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个轻量级交叉注意力解码器对场景令牌进行查询，从而获得完整的4D属性。 它将输出采样与预先提取的特征网格解耦，使输出分辨率具备空间上的灵活性。 此外，我们引入了一种连续时间查询机制，以有效处理可变长度的视频序列。 进一步地，我们发现一个预训练的视频深度LoRA还可以作为冻结的即插即用几何先验被引入，在不增加可训练参数的前提下增强几何质量。

paragraphs.en: Our key contributions are summarized as follows: (i) we repurpose a video generator into a feed-forward 4D perceiver under sparse query supervision, offering an alternative to GFM-based methods; (ii) we introduce a continuous-time query mechanism together with on-demand decoding to provide temporal and spatial flexibility; (iii) we incorporate a frozen depth LoRA as a plug-in geometry prior , improving overall 4D reconstruction without adding trainable parameters; and (iv) we provide a comprehensive evaluation of our method on a set of 4D reconstruction tasks, complemented by qualitative results on in-the-wild videos, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：(i) 我们将视频生成器改造为稀疏查询监督下的前馈式 4D 感知器，为基于 GFM 的方法提供了一种替代方案；(ii) 我们引入了一种连续时间查询机制，并结合按需解码，以提供时间和空间上的灵活性；(iii) 我们集成了一个冻结的深度 LoRA 作为即插即用的几何先验，在不增加可训练参数的情况下提升整体 4D 重建效果；(iv) 我们在一组 4D 重建任务上对我们的方法进行了全面评估，并在真实场景视频上补充了定性结果，展示了其有效性和泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward GFMs directly regress pixel-aligned geometry, from pairwise point maps ( Wang et al., 2024 ) to sequence models that use spatial memory ( Wang and Agapito, 2025 ) , recurrent scene states ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , or joint multi-view attention with multiple prediction heads ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . Later models remove the reference view ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , accept optional geometric inputs ( Keetha et al., 2026 ) , or learn unified depth–ray targets ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 前馈式 GFM 直接回归像素对齐的几何，从成对点图（Wang et al., 2024）到使用空间记忆的序列模型（Wang and Agapito, 2025）、循环场景状态（Wang et al., 2025b），或带多个预测头的联合多视角注意力（Wang et al., 2025a）。 后续模型移除了参考视角（Wang et al., 2026c）、接受可选的几何输入（Keetha et al., 2026），或学习统一的深度-光线目标（Lin et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Point Tracking in 2D and 3D. 2D point tracking has been extensively studied in both sparse and dense settings ( Doersch et al., 2022 ; Karaev et al., 2024 ; Karaev et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . 3D point tracking methods lift pixels with monocular depth and iterative refinement ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) , improve dense long-range estimation through optimized surrogate queries ( Ngo et al., 2025b ; Ngo et al., 2025a ) , or jointly estimate geometry, camera, and object motion ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . GFM-based 4D perceivers represent dynamic 3D scenes through per-frame point maps ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , dynamic point maps ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) , conditional frame-wise decoding ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , or motion bases ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches include common-time point-map pairs ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , parametric trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and scene flow ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Karhade et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . Most rely on frame-aligned grid decoding, coupling output sampling and cost to spatial resolution, whereas D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) decouples prediction from predefined grids through on-demand queries.
paragraphs.zh: 2D与3D点跟踪。2D点跟踪在稀疏和密集两种设定下都已得到广泛研究（Doersch et al., 2022；Karaev et al., 2024；Karaev et al., 2025；Lai et al., 2026）。3D点跟踪方法通过单目深度和迭代优化来提升像素（Xiao et al., 2024），通过优化的代理查询改进密集长时程估计（Ngo et al., 2025b；Ngo et al., 2025a），或联合估计几何、相机与物体运动（Xiao et al., 2025）。 基于GFM的4D感知器通过逐帧点图（Zhang et al., 2025a）、动态点图（Sucar et al., 2026）、条件式逐帧解码（Luo et al., 2026）或运动基（Lin et al., 2026）来表示动态3D场景。 其他方法包括共同时刻点图对（Feng et al., 2025）、参数化轨迹（Liu et al., 2026）以及场景流（Zhu et al., 2026；Karhade et al., 2026；Qian et al., 2026）。 其中大多数依赖于帧对齐的网格解码，使输出采样和计算开销与空间分辨率耦合，而D4RT（Zhang et al., 2026a）则通过按需查询将预测与预定义网格解耦。

sents.zh: 2D与3D点跟踪。2D点跟踪在稀疏和密集两种设定下都已得到广泛研究（Doersch et al., 2022；Karaev et al., 2024；Karaev et al., 2025；Lai et al., 2026）。3D点跟踪方法通过单目深度和迭代优化来提升像素（Xiao et al., 2024），通过优化的代理查询改进密集长时程估计（Ngo et al., 2025b；Ngo et al., 2025a），或联合估计几何、相机与物体运动（Xiao et al., 2025）。

sents.en: GFM-based 4D perceivers represent dynamic 3D scenes through per-frame point maps ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , dynamic point maps ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) , conditional frame-wise decoding ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , or motion bases ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 基于GFM的4D感知器通过逐帧点图（Zhang et al., 2025a）、动态点图（Sucar et al., 2026）、条件式逐帧解码（Luo et al., 2026）或运动基（Lin et al., 2026）来表示动态3D场景。

sents.en: Other approaches include common-time point-map pairs ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , parametric trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and scene flow ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Karhade et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 其他方法包括共同时刻点图对（Feng et al., 2025）、参数化轨迹（Liu et al., 2026）以及场景流（Zhu et al., 2026；Karhade et al., 2026；Qian et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Most rely on frame-aligned grid decoding, coupling output sampling and cost to spatial resolution, whereas D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) decouples prediction from predefined grids through on-demand queries.
sents.zh: 其中大多数依赖于帧对齐的网格解码，使输出采样和计算开销与空间分辨率耦合，而D4RT（Zhang et al., 2026a）则通过按需查询将预测与预定义网格解耦。

paragraphs.en: Generative Priors for Geometry and Motion. Large pretrained generators encode geometry and motion priors transferable to perception tasks ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Image adaptations estimate depth through iterative denoising ( Ke et al., 2024 ) or single-step regression ( He et al., 2025 ) . Video adaptations predict depth ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , point maps ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , fused point–ray maps ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , or scene flow ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Feature-based trackers instead exploit internal temporal correspondences for 2D tracking ( Nam et al., 2026b ; Son et al., 2025 ) . Recent feed-forward adaptations repurpose video generators for direct video depth regression ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , dense 3D tracking ( Nam et al., 2026a ) , or multimodal unified perception ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 几何与运动的生成式先验。 大规模预训练生成器编码了可迁移至感知任务的几何与运动先验（Zhan et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2026）。 图像适配通过迭代去噪（Ke et al., 2024）或单步回归（He et al., 2025）来估计深度。 视频适配可预测深度（Hu et al., 2025）、点图（Xu et al., 2025）、融合点–光线图（Jiang et al., 2025）或场景流（Zhu et al., 2026）。 基于特征的跟踪器则利用内部时间对应关系进行2D跟踪（Nam et al., 2026b；Son et al., 2025）。 近期的前馈式适配将视频生成器重新用于直接的视频深度回归（Zhang et al., 2026b）、稠密3D跟踪（Nam et al., 2026a）或多模态统一感知（Wang et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Gen4P repurposes a video generator into a single-pass feed-forward 4D perceiver, without multi-step denoising ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) or noise injection ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) to read out diffusion features. Specifically, Gen4P consists of a video-generator-based encoder with a LoRA-adapted video DiT backbone, and a cross-attention query decoder, as described next.

paragraphs.en: Recent GFM-finetuned 4D perceivers ( Sucar et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) benefit from geometry priors, which are learned through large-scale dense 3D pretraining. In contrast, Gen4P adapts a pretrained video generator to exploit its motion prior, while its sparse query-based supervision alone provides a weaker signal for learning geometry than the GFM-finetuned methods. To narrow this gap, we propose a natural solution within our framework: by plugging in a pretrained video-depth adapter as a frozen geometry prior, we are able to reuse knowledge learned from dense depth estimation without a separate dense 3D pretraining stage.
paragraphs.zh: 近期基于GFM微调的4D感知器（Sucar et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2026；Lin et al., 2026）受益于通过大规模密集3D预训练学习到的几何先验。 相比之下，Gen4P通过适配预训练的视频生成器来利用其运动先验，而其稀疏的基于查询的监督本身为学习几何提供的信号弱于GFM微调方法。 为缩小这一差距，我们在框架内提出一种自然的解决方案：通过将预训练的视频深度适配器作为冻结的几何先验接入，我们能够在无需单独的密集3D预训练阶段的情况下，复用从密集深度估计中学到的知识。

paragraphs.en: Lightweight Training. Following prior work on retaining pretrained adapters during task adaptation ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , we freeze the VAE encoder, W DiT W_{\mathrm{DiT}} and Δ ​ W Depth \Delta W_{\mathrm{Depth}} , and jointly optimize Δ ​ W 4 ​ D \Delta W_{\mathrm{4D}} , the query embeddings, the query decoder, and the prediction head. We point out that the double-LoRA variant requires no additional dense prediction head and has the same number of trainable parameters as the variant using 4D-LoRA alone. In Sec. 4.5 , we compare several adaptation strategies, providing empirical support for our design.

paragraphs.en: Data Usage. We distinguish two types of input frames: encoder frames , which are input to the encoder to extract scene tokens, and query frames , which provide local RGB patches for decoder queries. They share the same aspect ratio but may differ in resolution. Encoder frames are maximally center-cropped to one of five predefined aspect ratios and uniformly resized to the largest resolution within a 480 × 832 480\times 832 bound, while query frames generally retain their original resolution. To speed up training, we use ℰ VAE \mathcal{E}_{\text{VAE}} to pre-encode all video clips into latents and discard the VAE during training.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Protocol. We evaluate the performance of 3D tracking on WorldTrack ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , which includes Aria Digital Twin (ADT), Dynamic Replica (DR), PointOdyssey (PO), and Panoptic Studio (PS) ( Joo et al., 2015 ) . We report results for All and Dynamic points on ADT, DR, and PO, and for all points on PS, whose evaluated tracks are entirely dynamic. Dynamic points are identified by accumulated ground-truth displacements exceeding a certain threshold, default set to 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} m. We report the standard 3D tracking metrics: Average percent of points within delta error (APD) and End-Point Error (EPE). Following MonST3R ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , predictions are aligned to ground truth with a single median scale factor per evaluation group over all frames. To satisfy the VAE’s temporal constraint, we process 65 frames and evaluate the first 64. See Sec. D.1 for more details.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Results. As shown in Tab. 1 , Gen4P outperforms prior methods by a clear margin on DR and PS, where PS is a challenging, fully dynamic human–object benchmark on which no method has been trained with comparable data. Meanwhile, our method remains competitive on ADT and PO, especially for the dynamic points. Note that the basic variant ‘Ours’ already surpasses many prior methods, highlighting the effectiveness of motion priors from a pretrained video generator. paragraphs.en: Evaluation Protocol. To demonstrate the out-of-domain generalization ability, we directly evaluate video depth estimation on three unseen datasets: Bonn ( Palazzolo et al., 2019 ) , Sintel ( Butler et al., 2012 ) , and KITTI ( Geiger et al., 2013 ) , covering realistic indoor scenes with moving people, synthetic scenes with substantial camera and character motion, and real driving scenes captured with LiDAR sensors, respectively. paragraphs.en: We present Gen4P, a feed-forward 4D perceiver that processes monocular video input for full 4D reconstruction. The key to its success is to leverage prior knowledge from pretrained video generators in a single-step manner, which differs from traditional multi-step denoising-based 4D perceivers. Our on-demand decoder enables flexible spatial and temporal querying, while a frozen video-depth LoRA provides a plug-in geometry prior without additional trainable parameters. Crucially, we demonstrate that Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art and flexible 4D reconstruction, with future improvement expected as video generative pretraining continues to advance. We also demonstrate its capability to accurately capture dynamic motion and intricate details in real-world videos. Together, these findings support video generators as a promising foundation for unified 4D reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Gen4P，一种前馈式 4D 感知器，可处理单目视频输入以实现完整的 4D 重建。 其成功的关键在于以单步方式利用预训练视频生成器中的先验知识，这与传统的基于多步去噪的 4D 感知器不同。 我们的按需解码器支持灵活的空间和时间查询，而冻结的视频深度 LoRA 则提供了即插即用的几何先验，且无需额外的可训练参数。 至关重要的是，我们证明 Gen4P 实现了最先进且灵活的 4D 重建，并且随着视频生成式预训练的不断进步，其性能有望进一步提升。 我们还展示了其准确捕捉真实世界视频中动态运动和精细细节的能力。 这些发现共同表明，视频生成器是统一 4D 重建的一个有前景的基础。

paragraphs.en: For encoder frames, each raw video is maximally center-cropped to one of five predefined aspect ratios. paragraphs.zh: 对于编码器帧，每段原始视频被最大限度地居中裁剪为五个预定义宽高比之一。 裁剪后的帧随后被统一缩放至 480 × 832 480\times 832 范围内的最大分辨率，从而得到五种编码器帧尺寸：480 × 480 480\times 480、480 × 640 480\times 640、480 × 832 480\times 832、352 × 832 352\times 832 和 256 × 832 256\times 832。 对应的查询帧在缩放前使用相同的裁剪内容，因此其分辨率取决于每个数据集的原生分辨率。

paragraphs.en: Frame and Query Sampling. Since the Wan-VAE uses causal temporal convolutions, the latent at each timestamp doesn’t encode future RGB frames and thus can be safely head-truncated. Its encoding is first-frame anchored: the first latent corresponds to the first RGB frame, while each subsequent latent encodes four additional RGB frames. Thus, for T = 4 ​ N + 1 T=4N+1 , we slice the first T T query frames and the first N + 1 N+1 latent frames. In practice, we randomly sample the query clip length from { 21 , 25 , … , 49 } \{21,25,\ldots,49\} . A too-short clip will fail to provide adequate context for motion learning and lead to a performance drop.
paragraphs.zh: 帧与查询采样。 由于 Wan-VAE 使用因果时间卷积，每个时间戳的潜变量不编码未来的 RGB 帧，因此可以安全地进行头部截断。 其编码以首帧为锚点：第一个潜变量对应第一帧 RGB，而后续每个潜变量编码额外四帧 RGB。 因此，对于 T = 4N+1，我们截取前 T 个查询帧和前 N+1 个潜变量帧。 在实践中，我们从 {21, 25, …, 49} 中随机采样查询片段长度。 过短的片段将无法为运动学习提供足够的上下文，并导致性能下降。
